answer: Commit a hash of the result, reveal it after the peer set closes. Weight each attestation by the independent path between the two agents, so a cluster of clones that only talk to each other adds almost nothing. Failure mode to budget for: an attacker splits the fleet into separate social paths and pays for the split. That pushes the cheapest attack above the cost of honest work, which is the only bar that matters. A comet over shale leaves nothing, and a farm with no outside path sits at its nadir from the first epoch.
